hosted_service.evidence: Long-lived Flask API, Celery workers, web, plugin daemon and agent_backend services in docker/docker-compose-template.yaml (agent_backend at 654-670).

machine_actions.evidence: Service API and MCP server controllers api/controllers/service_api, api/controllers/mcp; agent runtime pushes config via inner API (api/controllers/inner_api).

agent_mutations.evidence: In build mode the Dify agent can mutate its own Agent config (notes, env, files, skills) with `dify-agent config ... push/delete` (dify-agent/src/dify_agent/layers/config/layer.py:29-48); server permits these writes only on the user's DEBUG_BUILD draft (api/services/agent_config_service.py:913-929, 968-983). AI also drafts/refines workflow graphs (api/services/workflow_generator_service.py:36-88).

evolution_auto_apply.evidence: AI changes land in a per-user build draft; applying it to the agent draft is a console action (api/controllers/console/agent/roster.py:953 /agent/<id>/build-draft/apply) and publishing a version is separate; workflow generator returns a graph to the editor (workflow_generator_service.py:44-88). No learning loop that applies changes itself was found.

definition_change_path.evidence: Apps, workflows, agents, skills, knowledge bases, tools and model providers are configured at runtime through the console API/UI (api/controllers/console).

code_release_path.evidence: Evolution lanes (workflow generator, agent build mode) produce definitions stored in the DB/object storage; no first-party lane ships Dify code (searched api/services/agent, api/services/workflow_generator_service.py, dify-agent/src).

DEL-11.evidence: Releases are versioned images (docker-compose-template.yaml image tags e.g. langgenius/dify-agent-backend:1.17.1 at 655) that can be redeployed; Alembic downgrade exists for every migration but no tested one-step rollback or cross-release compatibility guarantee found.

ARC-02.evidence: Alembic migration framework; all 219 migrations define downgrade() (grep -L 'def downgrade' returns none), e.g. api/migrations/versions/fecff1c3da27_remove_extra_tracing_app_config_table.py downgrade recreates table. CI db-migration-test (.github/workflows/db-migration-test.yml:31-35 offline SQL generation for upgrade base:head and downgrade head:base; :59 `flask upgrade-db` against an empty database), wired into main-ci.yml:511-532. Not 3: migrations are not exercised against representative data, no expand-and-contract tooling enforced; runtime definitions (workflow graphs, agent configs) are JSON documents and do not go through migrations (graph migrations happen in code on read).

GOV-10.alt_note: The one AI self-change path (agent build mode) is enforced server-side: config pushes are accepted only on the calling user's DEBUG_BUILD draft of an agent in the same tenant, published snapshots and the shared draft are not writable from the runtime surface, and a human applies and publishes. That is a declared scope with a small blast radius; held at 2 because there is no rate/volume limit, no evidence blocked attempts are logged beyond a 403, and the workflow generator path is unbounded (it relies on the human applying the returned graph).
